purpose: Define the machine-readable lifecycle from cortex-authored repo mutation to sovereign Forgejo coordination, Kernel mempool dispatch, and registry-mediated production convergence.

sovereign_forge.forge_authority: Forgejo is the priority sovereign forge authority for agency/privacy-sensitive lifecycle coordination; GitHub remains the external proprietary upstream, backup, publication and intelligence source.
sovereign_forge.git_role: Git remains the content-addressed DAG, local membrane and archival substrate; it is not the lifecycle authority by itself.
sovereign_forge.kernel_role: The Kernel is the nervous-system bus for tasks, claims, observations and read-back evidence.

organ_roles.organ-forge: Perceives forge/repo state, coordinates claims and dispatches lifecycle intent.
organ_roles.organ-lifecycle: Converges registry-selected runtime, build, validation and deployment state.
organ_roles.organ-exposure: Projects organism capabilities to cortex adapters and MCP surfaces.
organ_roles.organ-framework-map: Observes external frameworks so execution routes can be selected from evidence.

forbidden_authorities: GitHub pull request state as canonical lifecycle truth
local git commit as production evidence

fractal_recursion.rule: Every lifecycle layer must expose the same recursive shape: intent, claim, route, execute, observe, result, converge.
non_recursion_smells: provider-specific route with no generic envelope
state transition without evidence at its own scale

production_definition.non_deploying_profile_exception: release_validated may transition to production_observed when the completed lifecycle task is the effective runtime evidence

forbidden_shortcuts: cortex local shell build presented as canonical supply chain
committed source diff presented as production evidence
GitHub or generic git host state presented as sovereign lifecycle authority
runtime status promoted without registry authority
mempool dispatch claimed without pending or completed read-back
